title: 洋基队也缺钱？：26亿美元融资，背后隐藏什么
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So the valuation rental, how to read us, you tell me.
segments.zh: 那么估值租金，你怎么解读，你告诉我。

segments.en: Well, they didn't disclose the valuation and I think that is something that everyone has questions about private equity firms are permitted to invest up to 15 percent into a club,
segments.zh: 他们没有披露估值，我认为这是大家都关心的问题。私募股权公司最多可以**俱乐部15%的股份，

segments.en: but $2.6 billion is a lot of money, of course there's going to be a mix of debt and equity, but they didn't say a number, but I mean, just speculating it has to be over $13 billion
segments.zh: 但26亿美元是一大笔钱，当然会有债务和股权的组合，但他们没有给出具体数字，但我的意思是，仅从那个数字的规模来看，估值肯定超过130亿美元。

segments.en: just off of the sheer strength of how high that number is.
segments.zh: 仅从那个数字的规模来看。

segments.en: Brandon, why is this happening now? I think there's a question a lot of people are going to ask and I think a lot of people would think the Yankees is like ironclad brand, known throughout the world, sells a lot
segments.zh: 布兰登，为什么现在发生这种情况？我想很多人会问这个问题，很多人会认为洋基队是一个铁板品牌，闻名世界，卖很多服装和门票，

segments.en: of apparel tickets as well, is there a need for this kind of investment at the club right now?
segments.zh: 现在俱乐部需要这种**吗？

segments.en: I think they saw one. And if you think about the MLB calendar as it sits right now, the Yankees will likely go to the playoffs, but there are questions surrounding whether there will be an MLB season at all
segments.zh: 我认为他们看到了需求。如果你考虑一下目前MLB的赛程，洋基队很可能会进入季后赛，但围绕下赛季MLB是否会有赛季存在疑问。

segments.en: next year. Of course, the players union and the MLB will be collectively bargaining with the issue being a salary cap versus no salary cap and whether the players and owners can come to terms on that
segments.zh: 当然，球员工会和MLB将进行集体谈判，问题是工资帽与无工资帽，以及球员和老板能否及时达成协议，为下赛季做好准备。

segments.en: in time for next year's season. And everybody that I speak to says it isn't likely.
segments.zh: 我交谈过的每个人都说不大可能。

segments.en: And so from that perspective, now you're losing money on games, there's 81 home games a year and teams alongside the Yankees will be losing that.
segments.zh: 所以从这个角度看，现在你在比赛上亏钱，每年有81场主场比赛，洋基队和其他球队都会面临这种损失。

segments.en: We had a screen up there of the various firms that have been investing in sports and obviously franchises, values just seem to go higher and higher and higher.
segments.zh: 我们屏幕上展示了多家**体育领域的公司，特许经营权价值似乎越来越高。

segments.en: This is a little bit of a different kind of a deal though.
segments.zh: 不过，这笔交易有点不同。
